metadata.description: Epoch-1 package-authored native mechanism manifest. Object readers are permissive for additive evolution; closed vocabularies and relational admission remain exact.
x-relational-laws: descriptor-id: descriptor ids are nonblank, bounded, control-free and unique within one manifest
descriptor-name: descriptor names are nonblank, bounded and control-free
role-operation-set: build and package carry plan, fingerprint, apply and verify exactly once in canonical order; deploy carries those followed by remove and recover; acquire transport is deferred
artifact-kinds: artifact kinds are nonempty, unique and appear in shared vocabulary canonical order
protocol: protocol is exactly the mechanism protocol epoch admitted by the host
